duration_scenarios.method: 1000 bootstrap schedules with replacement from historical live per-question elapsed_s; greedy earliest-free-worker assignment; deterministic seed20261116+N+workers. Sensitivity model, not private performance prediction or statistical confidence interval.
assumptions: Same cost distribution as recorded E2 questions; no provider-load correlation or rate-limit changes.
No index startup or solution.py economy/controller effect included.
Workers2 is measured; workers8 is an unverified ideal concurrency scenario.
N50/100/200 are hypothetical sensitivity points, not the actual private question count.

recommendations.primary_rationale: Highest E2 and demo of the selected measured families; no corpus-bound assets. Historical wall used2workers, not4 or8. Unknown private workload prevents a guaranteed latency claim. Integrator can choose balanced/efficient profile based on actual startup and controller checks.

limitations: Historical review_live wall times do not include solution.py controller and cannot prove 20-minute performance on an unknown private workload.
Profiles were measured with local cache/preloaded node vectors where available. Removing shipped vectors is a requested packaging change; final archive quality/runtime remains to be validated.
Current provenance, safety, source-binding, observer and judge fixes differ from older runtime hashes; historical scores do not become new archive scores.
The two minimal runs use the same named feature profile but have different runtime hashes; variation is not proven to be solely generator noise.
Local lenient judge fabrication labels are not a legal audit.
No universal claim that precomputation is always worse is made; zero corpus-bound assets is the current explicit user constraint.
